comment: Newest date is what the website and phone show. Add an entry, deploy the API. Do not publish an EAS update just to change this text. See README: What's new.

notes.title: Check lots before you upload
items: Choose folder and Choose photos keep filename order, including camera times and IMG_9 before IMG_10, even past 100 photos. Divider sheets stay between the right lots.

Before Upload, the upload box shows how the photos split into lots. A new folder or a blank sheet starts the next lot, and the blank sheet is left out of the listing. A tape number can still split a group while cataloging.
When Post to CT Seller fails, the message names the problem and stays on that lot.

notes.title: Posting to CT Seller is fixed
items: CT Seller changed how new listings are saved. Post to CT Seller now sends the same details their form sends, including the category group (Glassware is Household Goods, Decorative Art is Antiques).
Try posting your unposted lots again. If one still fails, the message stays on that lot.

notes.title: Updates for your next sale
items: Big uploads now split lots correctly at white divider sheets, and smaller uploads process faster (lots run in parallel).
Add photos to CT Seller now updates photos you changed, like the AI white-background cover. The new Replace photos on CT Seller button refreshes all photos on the listing.
Set reserve works again and sends your reserve to CT Seller, including listings already posted.
Standard description (Account → Standard description) adds the same line to every listing, like 'Reserve is $5'. Sales can override it, and Add to unposted applies it to lots not yet posted.
Listing descriptions use more varied openers, and titles put the brand at the end unless it's the main search term.
